documents.title: Fragment on the Constitution and the Union
documents.source_citation: Collected Works of Abraham Lincoln, University of Michigan digital edition; Collected Works vol.4 pp.168-169

documents.selection_rationale: Lincoln privately reasons Union is 'picture of silver', liberty the 'apple of gold'. Rare explicit metaphor theorizing. High epistemic value.

documents.title: Letter to Horace Greeley

documents.provenance_notes: No special provenance caution recorded.
documents.selection_rationale: CRITICAL. 'If I could save the Union without freeing any slave I would do it.' Metaphor suppression event. Written 2 months before Preliminary Emancipation. Track covenant-over-freedom suppression.

documents.selection_rationale: Deliberately flat. Absence of birth/body clusters is the finding. Use as control document.

documents.title: Address Delivered at the Dedication of the Cemetery at Gettysburg
